submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
EDIT TARGET Image1 is our new W ready sprite. Repaint ONE new cast/W/02 early-gathering frame, maintaining its exact pure screen-LEFT side view, head/face PIXEL SIZE, costume/prop scale and square canvas placement. Images2/3/4 are respectively authoritative identity portrait, W idle camera, and main approved hand-painted Taoist chibi style. Never mirror any E image.
Anatomy/props: LEFT arm is camera-near, holding one bronze bell with red tassel. RIGHT arm is far, holding exactly FIVE separate red rectangular cards with golden flame motifs, spread like a compact fan. Two arms/two shoulders/two sleeve openings/two hands only.
New early-gathering pose: Knees bend just a little more than the ready target, pelvis and head lower naturally about1% of canvas height without resizing. Far RIGHT elbow draws its FIVE-card fan inward and slightly upward toward mid-chest, clearly gripping shared bases with thumb/fingers; all five panels distinguishable. Near LEFT forearm bends to lift the bell from thigh level toward lower ribs, handle/wrist/sleeve continuous, hand ahead of near torso silhouette so it remains readable. Torso remains mostly side-on, focused gaze to SCREEN LEFT. Shoes remain clearly separate and planted in target's modest stagger. Small physical shift from starting frame, no sudden deep lunge.
Preserve face features, chestnut high ponytail/red jewel crown, red-gold fire-pattern short robe, black pants, yin-yang waist ornament and red-black-gold shoes. Fixed whole-canvas camera and root x512/ground y920 at1024, no zoom, no bbox auto-fit, no growth. Aim for same target margins and natural body bob only; never independently resize head or shift lowest pixel to ground.
Single native square frame at least1024, intended1024x1024 RGBA. True transparent alpha, no background/ground/shadow/checkerboard, no particles, aura, detached flames, projectiles, text or labels. Clear hands/feet, rounded high-definition painted forms and restrained gold details.
